name: 一人公司 OS
description: 一人公司操作系统的核心插件外壳。在既有外壳、卡片协议、Magpie 网关与监控（opc-datad、成本熔断）、文件面板笔记 v1（编辑、问 Agent、批注、锁定）、卡片墙与 Bases 子集查询引擎、D5a 任务字段、工作流和卡住阶梯，以及 Paseo 安装路径修复之上，加上 D5b：opc-intake 接单引擎（默认观察模式）、工单阶段和 GitHub 端口。packages/intake-core 来自上游 6337fc8。不自动合并 PR。这份 registry 把安装提交钉到 a48dc49beee2df83f0878e412857958dd550e36b。修了 intake 状态机进 shared bundle 导致 node:crypto 打包失败（IntakeFlow 挪到 server）。这一版加上 D6：JSON Canvas（电脑用 xyflow 拖拽，手机只读）、Embed（电脑 iframe，手机截图降级）、/收集 和附件来源做实，Telegram、剪藏和 Grok 三入口只留端口。这一版加上 D7：显示名分组、顶部状态条，老人模式 dad 默认开、me 默认关；不卸 Better Paseo、Sidebar Organizer 和 Title Style。

readme: opc-core is the shell of opc-os. On top of the existing shell, the card protocol, Magpie gateway monitoring (opc-datad and a cost circuit breaker), file-panel notes v1 (edit, ask the Agent, annotations, and lock), the card wall and a Bases subset query engine, the D5a task fields, workflows, and stuck-escalation ladder, and the Paseo install-path fix, this pin adds D5b: the opc-intake engine (observe mode by default), ticket stages, and a GitHub port. packages/intake-core comes from upstream 6337fc8. It does not merge pull requests automatically. This registry record pins the install commit to a48dc49beee2df83f0878e412857958dd550e36b. It fixes the intake state machine landing in the shared bundle, which made packaging fail on node:crypto (IntakeFlow moved to server). This pin also adds D6: JSON Canvas (xyflow on desktop, read-only on mobile), Embed (iframe on desktop, screenshot fallback on mobile), a working /收集 command and attachment sources, and Telegram, clipper, and Grok left as ports only. This pin also adds D7: display-name grouping, a top status bar, and elder mode (dad on by default, me off by default). It does not uninstall Better Paseo, Sidebar Organizer, or Title Style. Magpie source is still not in this repository.
